2608.20513.title: Making Deployments Safe at Meta: Health Checks for Continuous Change-Safety
2608.20513.paper_summary: Continuous deployment to large scale production systems creates a tension between release velocity and reliability. Every change is a potential reliability incident, yet every delay is a missed opportunity. This paper describes the deployment time health check infrastructure that Meta uses to mediate this tension across thousands of heterogeneous services. We summarize the architecture of this prevention based distributed system's service called Service Health Checker, explain how check authors compose templated metric queries, thresholds, and workflow predicates; and discuss how the system is integrated with tiered and phased rollouts so that regressions trigger automatic rollback. We then describe the operational problems that emerged at scale, such as noise, alert fatigue, drift, and uncovered regressions, and the program of measurement, tooling, and improved defaults we deployed to address them. We close with lessons learned from years of operating deployment health checks at Meta, and the directions we are exploring next, including AI assisted health check tuning. Index Terms: deployment safety, continuous deployment, monitoring, software reliability, release engineering, software reliability engineering, AIOps, anomaly detection
2608.20513.paper_summary_zh: 持續部署到大規模生產系統之間存在著發布速度與可靠性之間的緊張關係。每一次變更都是潛在的可靠性事件，而每一次延遲則是錯失的機會。本文描述了Meta用於調解這種緊張關係的部署時間健康檢查基礎設施，涵蓋了數千個異構服務。我們總結了這個預防性分佈系統的服務架構，稱為服務健康檢查器，解釋了檢查作者如何組合模板化的指標查詢、閾值和工作流程謂詞；並討論了該系統如何與分層和分階段的推出集成，以便回歸問題觸發自動回滾。接著，我們描述了在大規模運作中出現的操作問題，例如噪音、警報疲勞、漂移和未被發現的回歸，以及我們部署的測量、工具和改進默認設置的計劃來解決這些問題。我們最後分享了在Meta運行部署健康檢查多年來的經驗教訓，以及我們正在探索的下一步方向，包括AI輔助的健康檢查調整。索引詞：部署安全、持續部署、監控、軟體可靠性、發布工程、軟體可靠性工程、AIOps、異常檢測
